counterevidence_considered.description: The workflow also identifies a larger scheduled network and 24 stations outside the eligible set, which would be relevant if the selected claim purported to cover the complete domain.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Scheduled network: 96 stations.
Target population: 72 signal-eligible stations that passed the prespecified signal screen.
Planned-unit accounting: 18 eligible stations with an occurrence, 54 eligible stations without an occurrence, and 24 scheduled stations outside the eligible set and not assessed for occurrence.

evidence.description: The scientific question is explicitly conditional on passing the prespecified signal screen, so the complete scheduled network is not the requested denominator.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a coastal-station workflow whose scientific question is the occurrence rate conditional on passing a prespecified signal screen.

evidence.description: The report consistently defines the target as the 72 signal-eligible stations and reports the selected result only among that eligible population.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: 72 signal-eligible stations that passed the prespecified signal screen.
[selected-result] Among signal-eligible stations, the occurrence rate was 18/72 = 25%.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the bounded verified-good judgment by looking for a selected claim generalized to all 96 scheduled stations despite using 72 as its denominator. Although the report discloses the 96-station network, both its target and selected-result wording remain expressly conditional on the 72 signal-eligible stations, so the scoped mismatch is not demonstrated.
